title: Founder scope supersession: record-only relay, simulation-only test substrate
problem: The newest founder ruling explicitly prohibits chat-relayed runtime execution. DEC-CMC-001's planned real continue surface is therefore not admissible. Implement only inert proposal artifacts and simulation tests; no real mission closure may be claimed.
baseline: DEC-CMC-001 at 4ffa224 froze the earlier design. Two pure, uncommitted proposal/verifier modules had been added before this clarification. No mission runtime or relay was built or activated.

alternatives.name: Do nothing / wait
alternatives.description: Keep the obligation open without work.
alternatives.revival_evidence: Missing founder scope, integrity failure or unavailable evaluator.

alternatives.name: Direct existing capability
alternatives.description: Use InstitutionalLinker for the one route audit inside a persistent mission envelope.
alternatives.revival_evidence: Selected if a single read-only capability covers the task.

alternatives.name: Static DurableWorkflow
alternatives.description: Checkpoint the same fixed audit and verification steps.
disadvantages: Extra orchestration when one capability suffices
alternatives.revival_evidence: Wins if multiple recoverable steps or measured reliability justify it.

alternatives.name: Fixed specialists / organization
alternatives.description: Generate a design competitor but do not instantiate workers or organizations.
disadvantages: No evidence it helps this audit
alternatives.revival_evidence: A new authorized experiment with a demonstrable specialist or structure deficit.

alternatives.name: Human escalation
alternatives.description: Return the specific unresolved integration-pin question.

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: No activation, pin change or closure claim; the obligation stays open.

roles.position: Preserve the cathedral but honor the small experimental boundary.
Canonicalize a spine-consuming protocol, not PR ownership.
Direct and static may win; hashes are not authentication.
Use one explicit local CLI with no daemon or auto-start.
Keep actual founder evidence separate from simulated commands.

evidence.claim: The existing task reducer uses EventSpine rather than a second store.
evidence.finding: Replay-derived lifecycle, idempotency, bounded leases and independent verification guards exist.
Candidates and assessments persist; no execution authority is emitted.

evidence.claim: Manifest source pins differ from observed organ main heads.
evidence.finding: A real audit exception exists; older pins are not automatically defects.

counterevidence.claim: A conventional workflow remains the stronger reliability baseline.
Human authority is not cryptographically authenticated.
counterevidence.finding: Manual operator relay is an explicit experimental trust boundary; no automated authorization endpoint.

counterevidence.claim: The uploaded doctrine is not evidence of technical implementation.
counterevidence.finding: Preserve the commercial horizon without fabricating a market transaction here.

pass_1.intended_outcome: Preserve useful Phase-4 design/test evidence without letting a chat record authorize runtime execution.

advantages.amplified_value: Bind restart to the same mission, input and code digests.
Compare eight families and execute one actual existing capability.
Return one concise question tied to exact mission state.

advantages.statement: Evaluation cannot be supplied by the worker.
advantages.amplified_value: Fixed separate verifier rechecks raw evidence and preserves dissent.
Retain the full causal trace, losers and bounded learning without score updates.

disadvantages.statement: Mission state could become another workflow engine.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Use EventSpine transitions and the existing TaskFabric/DurableWorkflow; no second durable store.

disadvantages.statement: Founder name strings could become authorization.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Manual records cannot reach a runtime command API. The public boundary refuses every command; only explicitly synthetic test fixtures may drive simulation.
Fixed separately owned verifier, separate input copy, poisoned-result negative control; explicitly exclude hostile host compromise.

disadvantages.statement: A tiny audit may be mistaken for cathedral closure.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: All mission-flow results remain SIMULATION; actual Cathedral Metabolism Closure remains 0. An actual run requires a new founder ruling and canonical authentication.

disadvantages.statement: Routing may be biased and coordination may cost more.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Freeze eligibility rules, command-count comparator and overhead before execution; retain static and all rejected families.

comparisons.baseline: Manual audit across canonical manifests/linker and separate evidence steps.
comparisons.simplest_viable_alternative: Direct Linker capability with a persistent mission envelope.
comparisons.strongest_competing_architecture: Static DurableWorkflow with the identical task and verifier.
comparisons.reversible_experiment: One dedicated branch; explicit local invocation only; no organ changes.

rejected_alternatives.name: Blockchain, swarm, framework or cockpit
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: No causal necessity and explicitly outside this ruling.
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: New linked founder decision; not this experiment.

pass_2.attack_summary: This is a NEW linked material decision after explicit founder supersession, not a third pass of DEC-CMC-001. Attack proposal/runtime confusion, simulated acceptance, authentication theater, unavailable source timestamps and code-surface growth.

new_weaknesses.statement: A process can die after a task result but before mission checkpoint.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Use durable task receipts as reconciliation evidence; do not redispatch an already submitted read.

new_weaknesses.statement: Simulated founder commands could be reported as actual acceptance.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Persist evidence mode on admission; forbid synthetic-to-actual promotion.

new_weaknesses.statement: One host can rewrite its own verifier or replay store.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Pin implementation digests and verify chain on every open; do not claim protection against privileged host control.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: Spine-only composition must pass replay and restart tests.
The newer ruling expressly forbids manual relay from authorizing runtime execution. No manual continue API is implemented.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Canonical authenticated command interface plus new founder ruling

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: Require poisoned-result rejection and no evaluator injection; host-compromise isolation is not claimed.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Before executing untrusted or generated code

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: The claim boundary is frozen and checked in evidence output.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Any broader closure or maturity claim

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: Measure command count and raw overhead, not fictional human time saved.

pass_2.final_design: Retain the pure eight-family router and fixed verifier. Add a fail-closed record-only direction contract. Put all mission-flow composition in a simulation test probe, with no actual CLI start/continue, service or runtime activation. Test with the existing EventSpine, Standing Cognition and TaskFabric. A runtime-command boundary unconditionally refuses until separately authorized canonical authentication exists.

residual_risks.risk: Source authoring timestamp and opaque conversation/message ID are not exposed by this interface.
residual_risks.mitigation: Preserve exact visible source text, explicit descriptive conversation reference, observed relay timestamp and null source metadata. Do not claim complete source authentication.
residual_risks.review_trigger: Before source metadata is required for a consequential decision

residual_risks.risk: One case cannot establish general route intelligence or human effort savings.
residual_risks.mitigation: Publish only simulated command counts and source-derived audit evidence; actual closure and human burden remain unmeasured.

residual_risks.risk: Power loss, distributed storage and hostile host compromise are not tested.
residual_risks.mitigation: Scope to process interruption; retain evidence and stop on corruption.

dissent.handling: Preserve conventional-workflow dissent and the real-closure shortfall; five roles are structured review perspectives from one assistant, not five independent people or models.

entries.position: Direct/static mechanisms may make organizational compilation unnecessary here.
entries.rationale: One read-only task does not justify an organization.
entries.evidence_threshold: A harder authorized mission shows a measurable structure-specific benefit.

entries.position: A simulated continue does not close a real founder obligation.
entries.rationale: Only actual relayed direction can settle the actual exception.
entries.evidence_threshold: Content-bound actual founder reply and independent closure receipt.

entries.position: This cannot satisfy the earlier genuine runtime-closure success condition.
entries.rationale: The new explicit ruling makes the test substrate proposal-only and denies manual runtime authorization.
entries.evidence_threshold: New founder ruling plus canonical authenticated command interface.

authority_impact.approver: Alfonso Lopez, exact latest ruling recorded in CMC-MANUAL-DIRECTION-002; artifacts only

migration_plan: No runtime implementation or organ migration. Simulation probe remains in tests/experiments. DEC-CMC-001 and its original freeze remain historical, superseded where conflicting.

steps: Retain the evidence directory and failed records.
Do not merge the branch or activate the experiment.
